description: This file implements the Mem0MemoryService class, a component for integrating Mem0 memory storage with Pipecat. It manages storing and retrieving conversational memories, enhancing language model contexts, and processing related frames within the Pipecat framework.

classes.name: Mem0MemoryService
classes.description: A class that provides a memory service integrating with Mem0, capable of storing and retrieving conversational memories, and enhancing language model contexts within Pipecat.

classes.name: Mem0MemoryService.InputParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the Mem0 memory service, including search limits, thresholds, API version, system prompt, message addition mode, and position.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Mem0MemoryService with optional API key, local configuration, user/agent/run IDs, parameters, and host.

methods.name: _store_messages
methods.description: Stores a list of messages in Mem0, handling both local and cloud configurations.

methods.name: _retrieve_memories
methods.description: Retrieves relevant memories from Mem0 based on a query, using either local or cloud API.

methods.name: _enhance_context_with_memories
methods.description: Enhances the given language model context with relevant memories retrieved from Mem0.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, intercepts context frames to add memory retrieval and storage functionalities.
